core_obligations: Exactness at the first two terms (proof lines 2933-2945): by definition mu_{n,S} is the kernel of the n-th power map, so the sequence is exact at mu_{n,S} and at the first copy of G_m.

Surjectivity (proof lines 2945-2960): for a section of G_{m,S} over an object, the author produces a covering of that object (fppf, respectively syntomic) over which an n-th root exists, using that the relevant morphism becomes invertible after an fppf or syntomic cover.
Conclude (proof lines 2960-2967): surjectivity of the last map on the members of the covering gives exactness on the sites in question.
proof_roadmap: Read exactness at the first two terms off the definition of mu_n.
Lift an arbitrary section to an n-th root on the members of an fppf, respectively syntomic, covering.
Conclude exactness of the sequence on both big sites.
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the Kummer sequence 0 -> mu_n -> G_m -> G_m -> 0 is short exact for the fppf and syntomic topologies on the big site of a scheme (statement lines 2920-2931). Exactness at mu_n and at the first G_m is by definition (proof lines 2933-2945); the content is the surjectivity, for which the author shows that an n-th root of a unit exists over the members of an fppf, respectively syntomic, covering (proof lines 2945-2960) and concludes exactness (proof lines 2960-2967). The non-formal content is the local existence of n-th roots in these topologies. The claim is H2: one definitional part plus one covering argument.
